annotations.title: Steel lintel and beam span check (2024 Ontario Building Code Part 9)

description: The steel angle lintel or steel beam that the 2024 Ontario Building Code Part 9 tables list for an opening width in a brick or stone veneer wall or a masonry wall, with the 150 mm bearing rule. Not a stamped design.

bearing_mm.description: Optional: the bearing length you have at each end, to check against the 150 mm minimum.

member.description: angle = steel angle lintel; beam = steel beam supporting masonry veneer and a wood stud wall (veneer walls only).

opening_mm.description: Clear opening width in millimetres (300 to 6,000). Give only one of opening_mm, opening_ft. Default 2,000 mm.

wall.description: veneer-brick-70 = 70 mm brick veneer; veneer-brick-90 = 90 mm brick veneer; veneer-stone-100 = 100 mm stone veneer; solid-brick-100 = masonry wall, 100 mm brick (Table 9.20.5.2.-A, exterior angle); solid-stone-150 = masonry wall, 100 mm brick plus 50 mm stone facing (Table 9.20.5.2.-A, exterior angle).

name: steel_beam_lintel_span_check
